title: A Study to Evaluate Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of AB-1009 Gene Therapy (GAA Gene) in Adult Participants With Late-Onset Pompe Disease (PROGRESS-GT LOPD)
official: A Single-Arm, Open-Label, Dose-Escalation Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability and Efficacy of a Single Intravenous Infusion of AB-1009 in Adult Participants With Late-Onset Pompe Disease (LOPD)
summary: This is a single-arm, open-label, dose-escalation study to evaluate the safety, tolerability and efficacy of a single intravenous infusion of AB-1009 in adult participants with late-onset Pompe disease (LOPD).

sites.f: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania
University of Texas Southwest Medical Center
